quarterly_data.signal: August 2026 Bitcoin production and mining update (unaudited): Canaan mined 44 BTC and held 1,868 BTC and 0 ETH at month-end after selling its entire 3,952 ETH position and 54 BTC in late August at average prices of approximately US$2,400 per ETH and US$79,000 per BTC.
